---
title: "Nosé-Hoover System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& y \\
\dot{y} &=& -x-zy\\
\dot{z} &=& y^2-a
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=1$ and initial condition $(5,5,0)$.
